name: Consensus
summary: Search academic papers and get a verdict on whether the evidence agrees, with the supporting studies attached.
description:
Consensus answers a different question from most AI search: not "what do papers say about this" but "is there agreement". Its consensus meter — yes, mixed, no — plus a list of the specific studies behind it is a fast triage tool for anyone who has to defend a claim, and the summarisation is tied to retrieved snippets rather than to a model's memory.

Meter reading needs care: agreement across a small number of low-powered studies is not the same as settled science, and health topics attract exactly that pattern. Coverage skews toward indexed, English-language literature. Treat it as the first five minutes of a literature review, not the last.
